To check if a cell is empty, perform a bitwise OR operation on the opacity values of all voxels in the cell (or all contributing voxels for higher-order interpolation).

**Backtracking Check:** Sample the first point after leaping.
If this point is inside a non-empty cell, backtrack the ray origin backwards by sample steps until an empty cell is found.
Perform standard ray casting (sampling, compositing, shading) from the new start point.
